links.outcome: Rate of hallucinated or irrelevant citations in OpenEvidence responses to guideline prompts
links.effect: 127 PubMed-indexed citations across 15 prompts; zero hallucinated; 2.4% irrelevant.
links.quote: Across 15 prompts, OE generated 127 PubMed-indexed citations (mean, 8.5 per response; range 6-11) with zero hallucinated and only 2.4% irrelevant citations.

links.outcome: Accuracy, evidence-basis and hallucination rate of a retrieval-grounded (RAG) tool's guideline answers
links.effect: Median scores exceeded 4.0 in all domains, evidence-based 5.0 (5.0-5.0); zero hallucinated citations; no comparator without grounding.
links.quote: OE produced highly relevant, accurate, clear, complete, and evidence-based responses to AAOS ACLR CPG prompts, with trustworthy PubMed-indexed citations and no hallucinations.

screen.reason: Evaluates the performance and citation accuracy of the OpenEvidence RAG platform against AAOS clinical practice guidelines without testing a deployment practice or comparative safeguard intervention.
